_note: Byte ceilings. reference_max_bytes and corpus_max_bytes are tripwires, not caps: they do not forbid growth, they force it to stop and be accounted for here before it lands. Raise either only together with a line in _history saying what the growth bought. Lower them whenever reduction lands.
_history: Content reduction: ja-JP 72292, en-US 72675. Removed the preamble repeated in ten reference files and cut restatement from 02 and 10.

Structural: split methods/system-selection.md into selection + framework-application. Largest reference 14509 -> 11856 (ja-JP), both halves under the 100-line reference guideline, at a cost of 670 bytes (ja-JP) and 702 (en-US) in headers, cross-pointers, and router rows. Corpus ja-JP 72962, en-US 73377.

Content growth, deliberate: ja-JP 78048, en-US 78109 (+5086 / +4732). Bought the method's stated purpose, which the text did not previously carry — an openness precondition on activation that a closed problem space fails, stopping decided by exhaustion of material rather than by cost, cost handed to the human as their call, a fourth framework use (transition model) with its procedure, and the statement that a count guards against overclaiming rather than measuring value. Largest reference 11856 -> 14380 (ja-JP), still 80 lines.

Content growth, from a defect the method found in itself: ja-JP 78233, en-US 78261 (+185 / +152). A controlled run in an open problem space listed a preserved item and then broke it, because item 12 of 09-evaluation-and-domains checked that the list was written and never that the finished work honoured it. Item 12 now audits the list item by item and requires an unhonoured item to be reported as unhonoured.

Content growth, from a second defect: ja-JP 78879, en-US 78818 (+646 / +557). Handing cost-based cutoff to the human makes an interrupted run the normal case, and nothing said what its output is worth — so a run stopped by a usage limit was read as a converged result. 00-activation now states that a pass cut short from outside is not a pass that stopped, forbids judging increment at the point of interruption, and requires an unresumed handover to name itself unconverged and list the untried moves.

Reduction, by excision: ja-JP 78879 -> 71939, en-US 78818 -> 72211 (-8.8% / -8.4%). The skill is capability grounded in cultural frameworks; value judgments that do not support that capability were removed and relocated to the caller's context document. Retired 07-creative-patterns entirely (its layered-framework clause moved into 03). 00-principles-and-constraints lost three of four perspectives and four of five constraints, and became a statement of attribution and rule justification; the conflict-resolution authority moved to the core principle in ROUTER.

Content growth, deliberate, developed in parallel on origin/main from the pre-excision 78233/78261 baseline and reconciled here: bought two things the text carried procedurally but never told anyone to reach for. Layering orthogonal frameworks was written entirely as risk, and a second framework was gated as an exception admitted only when the first could not handle an information type; it now names the intersections of two grids as a source of structure no single framework yields, with orthogonality kept as the condition rather than the gate. The temporal and transition models sat as two uses among four with no reason to prefer them; they now say what placement cannot show. The transition procedure gained a fifth step keeping each factor's trajectory separate, because collapsing the factors averages away that different ones took different routes at different times. Paid for in part by removing the instruction to open without framework names when the audience's interest is unknown, which withheld the value source before it had been tried.

Merge of the two lines above: this branch's excision (down to 71939/72211) combined with origin's parallel growth from the pre-excision baseline. Measured after merging both sets of source changes: ja-JP 72902, en-US 73106. reference_max_bytes carried over unchanged at 14857/14566 (framework-application.md, already the largest reference on both sides).

Content growth, deliberate: ja-JP 72902 -> 75356, en-US 73106 -> 75900 (+2454 / +2794). Bought an explicit candidate-recall path between abstract probe and framework preview, plus structurally diverse search anchors for state grids, cycles/calendars, paths/flows, directions, and layers. The named cultural systems are retrieval anchors rather than embedded framework knowledge or adoption recommendations; detailed structure remains dynamically sourced and checked when used.

Build-link normalization: ja-JP 75356 -> 75366, en-US 75900 -> 75910 (+10 / +10). Router references now use source module paths so build-time link rewriting produces valid references/ paths in generated skills.
